text:
Date: 14 March 2031, when the probe reached its maximum depth and transmitted its final reading.

Person: Dr. Ilvane Corsetti, lead mission oceanographer at the Halvern Deep-Sea Institute.

Figure: The probe's descent took 6 hours 52 minutes at an average rate of about 1.4 metres per second.

Document/event: The Halvern Institute's "Marisol Trench Descent Report (Mission MT-7)", released at a press briefing on 16 March 2031.
